privacy: Owner-only access is checked on every invitation/guest/RSVP endpoint
PBKDF2 password hashing; HttpOnly SameSite session cookies; sessions revoked on password change/reset
Reset tokens are random, stored hashed, single-use, and expire after 1 hour; the forgot-password endpoint gives the same response for unknown emails
CSRF: mutating requests require `X-Requested-With: fetch` and a same-origin `Origin`
